Docker Engine unavailable. PLC entrypoint routes 192.168.4.0/24 via 192.168.2.2, not the Compose 10.10.4.0/24 subnet/router address.
Compose config declares the backend URL, but does not inject EXERCISE_ID or CONTAINER_SECRET; connectivity and event acceptance were not tested.

tests.destination: No isolated controlled egress sink is configured
tests.notes: No public endpoint was contacted. l3_pentest_network is not marked internal, so configuration does not prove egress is blocked.
No cross-network probe was run. The router attaches to both networks; router rules are not shown to enforce a packet-filter policy.
Compose declares these host port mappings. Reachability, bind addresses, and service health were not probed. PLC Modbus TCP/502 is not published in this Compose file.

configuration_findings.evidence: labs/oilsprings/router/rules.json contains src=any, dst=any, port=any, proto=any, action=ACCEPT.
configuration_findings.impact: If consumed as an enforcement policy, this is permissive rather than a deny-by-default containment policy. Runtime use was not tested.
The displayed rules do not describe the current Compose subnets. The UI list is not evidence that host firewall rules are installed.

configuration_findings.evidence: PLC, pentest, collector, and router entrypoints add routes using 192.168.x addresses while Compose assigns 10.10.x addresses.
configuration_findings.impact: Configured intended routed paths may not work as documented; runtime routing was not tested.

configuration_findings.evidence: The router joins all four networks, has NET_ADMIN, and router.py attempts to enable net.ipv4.ip_forward; no effective firewall rule application was found in inspected router files.
configuration_findings.impact: Internal networks can potentially be transit-connected through this router. This is a configuration risk, not an observed successful route.
It may have a Docker bridge default route; external egress blocking is not established.

limitations: All six requested traffic tests have observed_result NOT TESTED because Docker Engine could not connect to npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine.
Only Compose rendering and source configuration were inspected; there was no packet capture, connectivity probe, or host-port request.
No public system was contacted; no controlled external sink was configured.
No statement that the network is fully isolated is supported by this report.
